name: ER = EPR

phase_0.boundary_condition: The spacetime manifold and experimental light cone boundary that contains the nonlocal correlations.

VINIT.justification: The unmeasured void before state preparation, preconditioning the distinction between particle and antiparticle.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary of the experimental light cone that contains the entire entanglement process.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism propagating the Alice photon along her timelike trajectory to the detector.

AREV.justification: The reverse or spacelike separated descent propagating the Bob photon to his detector.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the Alice measurement outcome with the joint Hilbert space.

IMSCRIB.justification: The entangled state recognizing its own correlation across the spacelike interval without local signaling.

FSPLIT.justification: The co-multiplication splitting a single pump photon into two entangled daughter photons.

FFUSE.justification: The multiplication reconstituting the original singlet identity from the separated measurement branches.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where the Alice measurement confirms the expected quantum correlation.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch where the Bob measurement yields the opposite spin, violating local realism.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice holding both spin states simultaneously before wave function collapse.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible append-only classical bit string recorded after wave function collapse.

phase_3.void_description: Unmeasured quantum vacuum and unentangled state before preparation.
phase_3.true_description: Definite spin up measurement confirming constructive interference and correlation.
phase_3.false_description: Definite spin down measurement confirming destructive interference and local realism violation.
phase_3.both_description: Entangled superposition holding nonlocal paradice of both spin states simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the quantum vacuum and unentangled state preparation.
Establish the spacetime manifold and experimental light cone boundary.
Spontaneous parametric down conversion splits the pump photon into an entangled pair.
Alice photon propagates forward along her worldline to the measurement apparatus.
Alice detector registers a definite spin state, anchoring the affirmative correlation branch.
Alice measurement outcome composes with the joint Hilbert space tensor product.
Bob photon propagates along the spacelike separated worldline, anchoring the negative branch.
Bob detector registers the anticorrelated spin state, violating local hidden variable models.
The entangled pair self-references its nonlocal correlation across the spacelike interval.
The system holds the superposition of both spin states as a paradice before final projection.
The joint measurement fuses the spacelike branches, reconstituting the conserved singlet identity.
The irreversible wave function collapse permanently records the classical outcomes in the macroscopic detector.

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Nonlocal quantum correlation and entanglement link
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Unitary time evolution and measurement basis selection
phase_5.alfs_store: Quantum field theory vacuum and canonical commutation relations

phase_6.cycle_cost: Zero entropy for unitary evolution; Landauer cost only at measurement
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 because unitary propagation and entanglement preserve quantum information without erasure; entropy increases only at the irreversible collapse.
